proof_body:
by
  intro M
  have h := ArithmeticFunction.sum_Ioc_mul_zeta_eq_sum (R := ℝ) ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt M
  rw [ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_mul_zeta] at h
  rw [← h]
  induction M with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    have hk := ArithmeticFunction.sum_Ioc_mul_zeta_eq_sum (R := ℝ) ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k
    rw [ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_mul_zeta] at hk
    rw [Finset.sum_Ioc_succ_top (Nat.zero_le k), ← ih hk, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), ArithmeticFunction.log_apply, add_comm]
target_source: ∀ M : ℕ, Real.log (M.factorial : ℝ) = ∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 M, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * ((M / d : ℕ) : ℝ)
